headline: NLW compared enterprise AI studies from Ramp, Databricks and Arcana Research that show token usage growing far faster than spend and Anthropic leading enterprise share, with 68.8% of proprietary model tokens on Databricks' gateway. In the headlines, Nvidia's board ruled out Jensen Huang's return.

themes.title: Enterprise AI usage outpaces spend
themes.body: NLW compares three studies. Ramp found token usage up 36% over the past month while spend rose only 2%, with 72% of AI spend coming from engineering teams. Databricks reports a 281x gap between its 99th percentile and median user and argues cost per successful task will matter more than token price. Arcana found two-thirds of leaders lacked visibility into model and API spend.

themes.title: Nvidia board rules out Huang
themes.body: NLW cites a CNBC source saying Nvidia's board is focused on its investigation into Jensen Huang, run by Wachtell Lipton, and is not discussing his return, despite a petition with 180,000 signatures including Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney. He also notes a WSJ report that Huang demanded upfront payments for chips from neocloud bosses at a Berlin meeting.

whyItMatters: With token usage rising faster than spend, a 281x gap between heavy and median users and two-thirds of leaders unable to see model spend, cost per successful task and usage visibility belong in AI governance now.

episodes.title: How Business AI Use is Changing
episodes.summary: Headlines cover the Nvidia board ruling out Jensen Huang's return, a new Commerce Department rule on remote chip access amid a Bessent–Lutnick split, planned AI national champions, OpenAI's embedded safety evaluator deals, and a major US banking outage. The main episode compares Ramp, Databricks and Arcana Research studies showing enterprise token usage outpacing spend, rising model switching, spend concentration, and Anthropic's enterprise lead.
